featured_reviews.name: Sooraj Varrier
featured_reviews.review_text:
23rd Oct 2021 - Gave order for a 30inch wooden temple, promised delivery on 1st Nov. On the day of delivery, he said it will be delayed for 2 more days. We said okay, and we also placed order for sofa cum bed, sofa set with chairs, teapoy, dining set and dresser all of which he said will be ready in 8 days.

We had to do house warming and pooja on 13th Nov. He promised delivery on 12th. Today 12th Nov 2021 this crook not only sent a temple way different from what we ordered but it was a 24inch temple. The dressing on the sofa cum bed was totally different. And all other items was not even ready.

This guy ruined a good day for us. Sent back the temple and cancelled all other orders. I dont trust this guy or his products. Stay away from this place.
